metaTitle: found.as — your free contact page & digital business card
metaDescription: A free contact page and digital business card at found.as/you — one link and QR code for your profiles, links and contact details. No account, no cookies, no tracking. Hosted in the EU on renewable energy.

ldDescription: A free contact page and digital business card at found.as/you — one link and QR code for your profiles, links and contact details. No account, no cookies, no tracking.
hookHtml:
No account. No app. No tracking.
Just your page.
leadHtml: Your profiles, links, and ways to reach you — one little page at found.as/you or your own domain, shared by link or QR code.
stepsSub: No sign-up wall, no download — you're editing in seconds.
step1Body: Pick a name — or point your own domain at it. A password, done.
step2Body: Paste any URL or handle — it becomes a tidy button. Reorder, rename, theme.
step3Body: A link and a QR that saves your contact even with no internet.
shareSmall: One link + a QR — card, poster, signature.
includedHtml: Everything's included: themes, your photo and colors, an auto-made social preview card, a vCard QR that works offline, printable cards and a poster, an email signature, redirects, short write-ups, file drops, and any Google Font — served without ever calling Google.
noCatchSub: What most link pages do quietly, we don't.
no1Html: No account. Just an address and a password — no email, no signup.
no2Html: No tracking. No cookies, analytics, or ads — for you or your visitors.
no3Html: No cookie banner. No cookies or trackers means nothing to consent to — effortlessly GDPR-compliant, hosted in the EU.
no4Html: No lock-in. Bring your own domain and export any time. We handle the padlock.
no5Html: No paid tier. Every feature included, free forever — donations keep it running.
no6Html: No black box. Built on web standards: a valid h-card, links that prove they're yours (Mastodon's green check), and IndieAuth sign-in.
no7Html: No surprises. Your page changes only when you publish — visitors keep the last version until you're ready.
ctaBandSub: No account. No app. About a minute.
